title: trajectory_meta
description: The run's record of how it ended and whether it kept its trajectory. Until 2026-09-23 no schema existed, so nothing inside the forty-four files on disk could be checked -- and a check that reports a trajectory deleted outside the pipeline has to trust `written`, `file` and the hashes it reads. The discriminator `artifact` is what brings a file under this schema, so the forty-four written before it carry none and are not judged; a writer from this date stamps it.

trajectory.description: Whether a trajectory was written for this run and, if so, what lets it be REUSED instead of re-run. `written: false` must say why. A written trajectory is one file: `txt` is the format a writer produces from 2026-09-23 (plan.md 4.6, the person's request that analysis read the file rather than re-run); `gsd` is the legacy form eleven runs of that day left on disk before the rule, accepted so they validate if re-stamped, and not to be written next to a txt -- two copies of one trajectory are one fact in two places.

reason.description: required when written is false: why no trajectory exists, so absence is a record and not a silence

file.description: the file's name inside this run's directory

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the FILE'S BYTES. Integrity for reuse: a reader recomputes it and refuses a file that no longer matches, rather than silently re-running or reading something else.

coords_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the coordinate ARRAY in its source dtype, not over the text. The text hash moves with formatting -- digits, separators, line endings -- so it cannot say whether two runs produced the same positions; this one can, which is what shows which engine ran.

dtype.description: the source array's dtype, before it was written as text

sig_figs.description: digits written per value, following the source: 9 for float32 and 17 for float64 round-trip exactly. More than the source carries prints precision that does not exist.

time_base.description: the time column is the integer step index, never an accumulated float time

plan_hash.description: the plan this run executed, so the file can be traced to the conditions that made it

box.description: the simulation box as the engine held it

units.description: what the coordinates are measured in; reduced units name their length and time scales

columns.description: one entry per text column: step, particle id, UNWRAPPED position components (the MSD estimator requires them), and orientation where the model has one
